comments.author: @edwinhenry7531
comments.text: I will say that the best pizza I have ever eaten was in Kuwait City.  Since I don’t eat pork, I did not have to ask if a dish was made with pork in it!  I will say there was an overwhelming amount of Filipinos working at every place in the country.  Also, many store owners were from other middle eastern countries!

replies.author: @edwinhenry7531
replies.text: @GlobalTravelGuide-68 I remember the restaurant was on the back side of a plaza,  the front was a huge I HOP.  The flavor and texture of the crust was first rate.  I also did not have to worry about any ingredients containing pork.

replies.author: @GlobalTravelGuide-68
replies.text: Now you’ve got me curious—what was so special about that pizza in Kuwait City? Do you remember the restaurant or what toppings you had?
